# `model_catalog`

Serves an OpenAI-compatible `GET /v1/models` catalog filtered per principal.

## Configuration Notes

The proxy answers list (`GET {list_path}`) and lookup (`GET {list_path}/{id}`) requests itself from configured entries; nothing is forwarded upstream. Each entry may restrict visibility to authenticated subjects, roles, or teams. Hidden and unknown models both return the same `404 model_not_found`, so callers cannot probe for models they cannot see. Catalog metadata (provider, version, capabilities, cost tier) is operator-declared and appears under a `praxis` key that OpenAI clients ignore. Other paths pass through untouched.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `list_path` | string | no | Path serving the model list. `{list_path}/{id}` serves one model. |
| `created` | integer | no | Unix timestamp reported as `created` when an entry omits its own. |
| `default_visibility` | `public` \| `authenticated` | no | Who may see entries that have no `visible_to` rule. |
| `models` | object[] | yes | Catalog entries in listing order. IDs should be the client-facing model IDs that inference routing accepts. |
| `models[].id` | string | yes | Client-facing model ID. |
| `models[].owned_by` | string | no | OpenAI `owned_by` value. Defaults to `provider`, then `praxis`. |
| `models[].created` | integer | no | Unix timestamp reported as `created`. Defaults to the top-level value. |
| `models[].provider` | string | no | Provider serving the model, reported in catalog metadata. |
| `models[].version` | string | no | Model version, reported in catalog metadata. |
| `models[].capabilities` | (`chat_completions` \| `completions` \| `responses` \| `messages` \| `embeddings` \| `audio_speech` \| `audio_transcriptions` \| `images` \| `realtime`)[] | no | Operator-declared API capabilities. These are not verified upstream. |
| `models[].cost_tier` | string | no | Coarse cost tier label, reported in catalog metadata. |
| `models[].aliases` | string[] | no | Additional IDs listed as their own objects with the same visibility. |
| `models[].visible_to` | object | no | Restrict visibility to matching principals. Absent uses `default_visibility`. |
| `models[].visible_to.subjects` | string[] | no | Authenticated subject IDs. |
| `models[].visible_to.roles` | string[] | no | Authenticated roles. |
| `models[].visible_to.teams` | string[] | no | Authenticated teams. |
